title: Baby Schedule
days.label: Days of the week
bridge.title: Show the baby's next activity in “Today at a glance”
bridge.lead: The baby's current or next activity appears as one task in “Today at a glance” on the home screen and in Wall Mode. Tick it off on any phone or the wall tablet and the next activity takes its place. If nobody ticks it, it moves on when the next activity's time comes.
bridge.advanced: Advanced: use a token you created yourself
bridge.tokenSaved: A token is saved – paste a new one only to replace it
bridge.tokenHint: Turn on creates a token that may only change tasks, and gives it to the Baby Schedule service, which never shows it again. It appears under Settings → Household → API access, where you can revoke it. Baby tasks are created in the name of the admin who turned this on.
bridge.statusOff: Off. Nothing from the baby schedule appears in “Today at a glance”.
bridge.statusIdle: On. There is nothing more planned for today.
bridge.taskNote: From the Baby Schedule. Tick it off and the next activity appears.
bridge.error.token_invalid: Yuvomi did not accept this token. Check that you copied all of it, or create a new one.
bridge.error.token_forbidden: This token may not change tasks. Create one with Tasks: write, and check that the Tasks module is switched on.
bridge.error.yuvomi_unreachable: The Baby Schedule service cannot reach Yuvomi right now.
bridge.error.yuvomi_unavailable: Yuvomi did not accept the request. It will be tried again in a moment.
bridge.error.not_installed: The Baby Schedule service is not reachable, so this cannot be set up yet.
bridge.error.admin_only: Only a household admin can change this.
bridge.error.internal: Something went wrong in the Baby Schedule service. It will try again.
bridge.error.csrf_invalid: The page was out of date. Press the button again.
bridge.error.token_create_failed: Yuvomi did not create the access token. Check that you are signed in as an admin and that the Tasks module is switched on, then try again.
widget.title: Baby today
widget.unavailable: The baby schedule can't be loaded right now.
quick.label: Quick add
upnext.label: Up next
empty.title: Nothing planned for {{day}}
empty.description: Add the first activity, or copy a day you have already planned.
empty.readOnly: Nothing has been planned for this day yet.
menu.title: Activity
menu.duplicateHint: Opens a copy you can change
menu.repeatHint: Adds the same activity to the days you pick
day.copyToHint: Use this day as the plan for other days
day.copyFrom: Copy another day into this one…
week.title: Plan the week
week.copyHint: Copy one day's plan to any other days
week.starterHint: A typical day of bottles, meals and naps to start from
form.name: Activity name
form.daysHint: Pick several days to plan them in one go.
form.alsoApplyHint: Only {{day}} changes unless you pick more days. On a picked day the same activity is updated, or added if it isn't there.
form.amountInvalid: The amount must be a number, for example 120 or 1.5.
mode.appendHint: Keeps the existing activities; exact duplicates are skipped.
mode.replaceHint: Removes the existing activities on those days first.
repeat.title: Repeat activity
repeat.hint: Days that already have this activity are left as they are.
move.title: Move activity
copy.title: Copy a day
copy.nothing: Plan a day first, then you can copy it.
starter.title: Example day
starter.lead: A typical day to start from. Change the times, foods and amounts to fit your baby afterwards.
templates.title: Week templates
templates.lead: Save the whole week as it is now, and bring it back later or try a different plan.
templates.saveLabel: Save this week as a template
templates.emptyWeek: Plan at least one activity before saving a template.
confirm.clearDayDetail_one: {{count}} activity will be removed. Other days stay as they are.
confirm.clearDayDetail_other: {{count}} activities will be removed. Other days stay as they are.
confirm.clearWeekDetail_one: {{count}} activity on all days will be removed. Saved templates are kept.
confirm.clearWeekDetail_other: {{count}} activities on all days will be removed. Saved templates are kept.
error.loadTitle: The schedule could not be loaded
error.setupTitle: The schedule service is not reachable
error.setupHint: The Baby Schedule needs its small backend service running next to Yuvomi. Ask your household admin to check it (see the module's README).
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.offline: You seem to be offline. Your schedule is safe; try again when you're connected.
error.not_installed: Requests to /api/extensions/baby-schedule/ reach Yuvomi instead of the Baby Schedule service. The service is not running, or the reverse proxy has no route for that path.
error.unreachable: The service did not answer. It may be restarting.
error.yuvomi_unreachable: The schedule service cannot reach Yuvomi to check your sign-in.
error.yuvomi_unavailable: Yuvomi could not confirm your sign-in right now.
error.yuvomi_busy: Yuvomi is busy. Try again in a minute.
error.read_only: You can view the schedule but not change it.
error.not_signed_in: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.account_inactive: This account is no longer active.
error.module_forbidden: Your household role doesn't include the baby schedule. An admin can change that under Settings → Household → Roles & permissions.
error.gone: This activity was removed, probably on another phone.
error.day_full: This day is full. Remove a few activities first.
error.too_many_templates: There are too many templates. Delete one first.
error.week_empty: The week has no activities to save yet.
error.rate_limited: That was a lot of changes at once. Wait a moment and try again.
error.csrf_invalid: The page was out of date. Please try again.
error.bad_origin: This change did not come from your Yuvomi page, so it was refused.
